claims.title: Exact ordered marked cubic and source inverse
claims.hypotheses: An original first-half exterior state at a prime p congruent to 1 modulo 8, with the ordered R,D marking retained.
nonclaims: The unmarked cubic alone reconstructs the ordered source.
The fixed-prime line has an integral source point for every hard prime.

claims.title: Every diagonal exterior state has an original middle return
claims.hypotheses: An original exterior state at p congruent to 1 modulo 8 with R=D.
nonclaims: A diagonal exterior state exists at every hard prime.
The map is injective after the positive odd fibre parameter t is forgotten.

claims.title: Hard-prime shape rigidity through radius eight
claims.hypotheses: An original exterior state at a hard prime p modulo 840 in {1,121,169,289,361,529}.
claims.strengthening: Any hard source in the radius-eight branch has p modulo 840 in {1,121}.
nonclaims: The radius-eight quartic has a hard-prime point.
The finite prefix through s=200000 classifies all integral points.
All remaining exterior shapes are bounded.

claims.title: Natural cubic involution does not preserve the fixed-prime source
claims.hypotheses: B is nonzero and X is nonzero on the marked cubic.
nonclaims: No other correspondence between the residue classes exists.
The displayed p'=5951 composite parameter is a prime source.
